d:
A love letter without a name. A blank call that changed everything. A best friend who thinks he’s the writer of your life.
This is a story of school-time pyaar, inspired by every desi 7th grader who thought love was like the movies. A boy, his overconfident best friend, and the girl he silently adored from the last bench and an unexpected turn. Then, the real story begins — one of guilt, growing up, and... gussa.
Created by Rishika Saria
Directed by Prince Shah
Written by Yashluv Virwani
Starring: Pranay Pachauri
Produced by Sharanya Rajgopal & Anuj Gosalia
